question: The Shaka dynasty in India was founded by _____.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Maues (Moga)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Maues (Moga)** was the first ruler of the **Shaka dynasty** in India.
 
• The Shakas were a group of **Central Asian nomadic tribes** who invaded India during the **2nd century BCE**.
 
• Maues established his rule in the region of **Gandhara** (modern-day Pakistan and Afghanistan).
